name: review-kit
description: A project review skill and an optional completion check.

audit.description: Review a requested change using project evidence
audit.content: Inspect $ARGUMENTS and the relevant project instructions. Read checklist.md beside this skill. Report concrete findings with file locations and evidence. Do not modify files.

files.checklist.md: Check correctness, cancellation, error handling, compatibility and whether tests exercise the changed behavior. Distinguish verified findings from uncertainty.

hooks.name: check-diff
hooks.description: Check the Git diff for whitespace errors on completion. Enable only in Git projects.
